pipeline.modality: Small molecule (4th-gen brain-penetrant EGFR MasterKey inhibitor)
pipeline.target: EGFR (classical and non-classical mutations, including C797S)

indications.trial_name: Phase 2 silevertinib in frontline EGFRm NSCLC
indications.trial_design: Single-arm Phase 2; 200 mg oral daily; 43 frontline patients enrolled (fully enrolled). Initial data Q4 2025: 60% ORR, 86% CNS ORR, 91% DCR. Updated DOR/PFS data planned Q2 2026.

indications.trial_name: Phase 2 silevertinib in recurrent EGFRm NSCLC
indications.trial_design: Single-arm Phase 2; 83 patients in 2L/3L setting; FDA Fast Track. Final data Q2 2026.

indications.trial_name: Randomized Phase 2 silevertinib + temozolomide vs temozolomide in newly diagnosed GBM
indications.trial_design: Randomized Phase 2; ~150 patients; safety lead-in of silevertinib + TMZ then randomization to TMZ vs silevertinib + TMZ. Primary endpoint: PFS by RANO BICR. Interim PFS analysis 1H 2028.

excluded_partner_owned.reason: Outlicensed to Servier in Q1 2025; Servier leads global development and commercialization across NSCLC and other solid tumors
